overall_critique.description: 1-3 sentence overall critique of the writing quality.

issues.description: Mark true only if the issue is noticeable enough to meaningfully lower writing quality.

coherence.description: Incoherent or nonsensical sentences or phrases.

wording.description: Unnatural phrasing, awkward wording, strange expressions, or incorrect terminology.

clarity.description: Problems with sentence clarity, structure, references, or tangled clauses.

grammar.description: Grammar, punctuation, spelling, agreement, or related mechanics problems.

logic.description: Misused connectors or weak local reasoning flow.

substance.description: Vague, generic, filler-heavy, or low-information writing.

repetition.description: Repeated phrasing, repeated patterns, duplicated content, or leftover/corrupted text.

overall_score.description: Overall writing-quality score. 5 = fully usable, 4 = usable with minor issues, 3 = borderline usable, 2 = not usable, 1 = major failure.
